reviewer: Amp local source review with a bounded read-only Lean review subagent; not independent external review
review_scope: Current PR18 against origin/main, with explicit assessment of current canonical definitions, Lean contracts and inherited boundaries, withdrawn terms, projections, and review enforcement. The prior eight-term findings remain in Git history and are superseded as current attestations. Only AC-D3, AC-D7 and AC-D8 are current theorem-backed contracts. Local promotion readiness is distinct from complete formal parity and downstream evaluation promotion.

findings.resolution: The active registry and dossier promote only Attention, Care and Respect. Intention, Fully Exercisable Permission, Constituted Exercise, Embodied Self-Governance, Absolute Attention, Sustained Attention and Love are withdrawn without identifier reassignment. Historical constructions and proofs are examples, not current promotion contracts. The residual governsEmbodiment signature is removed.

AC-D3 proves directed tracking in a supplied response model, with eight tests covering unilateral/reciprocal cases, cessation, narrow scope, isolated samples and contextual covariation. Participant identity, canonical Perception/Interpretation/Causal Contribution, admissibility of every contrast, and continuity between samples are not proved. Historical ratio/counting and participant-classifier proofs do not close those gaps.

AC-D7 proves response and Specification sensitivity of the same selector, with five bounded tests. A selector may systematically violate the criterion and still be sensitive to it; the theorem does not certify successful conformity or benefit. Canonical Attention, Entity, Action, Consequence, same-target joins and causal paths remain unproved. The use of canonical Specification does not close the surrounding semantic joins.

AC-D8 and seven bounded tests establish scoped admission with expressed conditions overriding contextual defaults. The condition map is indexed by target and operation; actor-specific or condition-specific Scope distinctions must be supplied in the operation carrier. Scope gates admission, not condition provenance. Canonical Action, Agency loss/restoration, actual causal regulation, consent and contextual accuracy remain unproved; admission or accidental conformity alone is not full Respect.

C41, C43, C45 and C46 retain prose anti-collapse commitments. Normative/epistemic predicates and universal interpersonal reversals are not replaced by proxy countermodels. Empirical applications require their own Specification and Evidence.

The review checker now requires every declared formal_evidence source pin. The new temporary-Git-repository regression fails without this requirement, passes with complete pins, rejects a missing second evidence pin, and detects its later source drift. This attestation also pins the Lean dependencies rather than only the marked theorem file.

Standing/Recognition separation has exact-index projection and countermodels. InstitutionalRevision and Self/Auto remain nonbinding. The older ExternalSovereignty recognition predicate is not the complete indexed RecognitionRelation; complete institutional parity remains gated. D111's retained restricted temporal witness is separately qualified in the embodiment review.

Implementation and evidence are separate commits. The active registry has 115 terms, 112 definitions and 53 commitments. New source-only evaluation records preserve historical runs and remain incomplete/hold because model generation and judgment were not rerun; they do not claim downstream quality or conformance.
